It includes other-channel filings before 9:00am that day. Preserve competing readings of "following its implementation" rather than treating the date-only and operational-launch candidates as equivalent.

The operational-launch candidates select an inclusive 9:00am boundary. The launch provisions support that interpretation, but the resubmission passage does not expressly settle exact-boundary inclusion or the governing timezone. That additional authority is absent and cannot be mapped to any supplied dependency ID.

The urgent-contact provision in da12aecad4e68.u12.1941 applies during the blackout. It does not establish that every email, call or fax is an actual STR submission, or create a general post-launch alternative-channel permission. Likewise, automatic migration under da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 does not by itself establish a new submission event.

No quoted trigger provision makes account registration, XML-schema conformity or e-Cert use a prerequisite to triggering resubmission. Adding those conditions would impose unsupported restrictions on the trigger. Their absence from a trigger formula does not establish compliance with the separate submission requirements.

The surrounding XML provision also requires firms to liaise with JFIU as soon as possible to arrange a technical test. That separate action is outside these trigger questions; the schema claim is supported as an atomic extraction but is not an exhaustive account of da12aecad4e68.u14.2439.

Its exact executable result, "Result: the fact report_has_postlaunch_other_channel_submission", does not implement the existential search. The source supports a 9:00am launch but does not expressly state the governing timezone or resolve exact-boundary inclusion in the resubmission provision. What authoritative JFIU clarification or applicable time convention resolves those points? Any necessary additional authority is absent and has no identifiable supplied dependency mapping.

The blackout provision in da12aecad4e68.u12.1941 directs urgent submitters to contact JFIU. It does not establish that every email, telephone call or fax constitutes an actual STR submission, nor grant a general post-launch alternative-channel permission. Automatic migration under da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 likewise does not itself establish a new submission event.
